configuration.runOrder: AB BA AB BA AB BA, with A=inside-TX control and B=current outside-TX
configuration.publishElapsedDefinition: Worker invocation start to return, excludes executor queue, setup and claim
configuration.comparison: Reconstructed inside-TX control vs unmodified current BillingWorkers.publishOne
configuration.ackWaitDefinition: Elapsed timed CompletableFuture.get call with 200ms scheduled completion, not actual Kafka latency
configuration.exclusions: Seed/claim SQL, probes, warmup, broker/network, HTTP/payment flow, production users and throughput
configuration.connectionAcquisitionDefinition: Elapsed Hikari getConnection call, separate from connection hold
configuration.connectionMsPerEventDefinition: Sum of all instrumented connection holds during publishOne/control, preventing bias from 1 vs 2 checkouts
configuration.percentileDefinition: Median midpoint for even samples, p95 nearest rank, raw values retained
configuration.contentionDefinition: 8 held acknowledgement futures and a single independent SELECT, 500ms connection timeout, no real Kafka
configuration.connectionHoldDefinition: Time from successful Hikari checkout until close returns, measured directly by DataSource wrapper
configuration.limitations: Local synthetic acknowledgement delay; reconstructed control; success benchmark plus transient timeout state checks, not a full failure drill
